newsitem.title: HAITI: Haiti airport closed briefly by strike.
newsitem.headline: Haiti airport closed briefly by strike.

text.p: The international airport in Haiti's capital closed for several hours on Wednesday after employees seeking the removal of its director walked off the job and barred passengers from entering, officials said.

At least one American Airlines flight bound for Haiti was rerouted to the Dominican Republic because of the walkout, said an airline official at Port-au-Prince International Airport who declined to give her name.
Workers cut off electricity and telephone communications to the airport and closed its doors, leaving passengers waiting outside the building in the hot sun.
Employees were demanding the removal of Ronald Neptune, the airport's general director, who they accused of corruption. Airport officials were unavailable to comment.

Haitian National Police Chief Pierre Denize and Minister of Communications and Transport Jacques Dorcean met with the employees in the afternoon and they agreed to go back to work, allowing the airport to re-open.
The rerouted American flight arrived in Port-au-Prince by mid-afternoon.
"Everything is back to normal now," the American employee said.
